## v2.4.1 — 2026-04-11

Version 2.4.1 is a critical security and stability patch that addresses multiple production audit findings including user project limits enforcement, atomic operations for draft transitions, race condition fixes, automatic refund handling on provisioning failures, performance improvements with LRU token caching, Redis atomic operations, and Docker resource limits.

### 🔧 Improvements

- Implemented LRU token cache to improve authentication performance and reduce memory usage.
- Enhanced Redis operations with atomic guarantees to prevent data inconsistencies.
- Added Docker resource limits to prevent container resource exhaustion and improve system stability.

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

- Enforced per-user project limits to prevent resource abuse and ensure fair usage across the platform.
- Implemented atomic draft transitions to prevent data corruption during concurrent state changes.
- Fixed TOCTOU (Time-of-Check-Time-of-Use) race condition vulnerabilities in critical code paths.
- Added automatic refund processing when provisioning failures occur to improve user experience.

### 🧹 Chores

- Updated documentation with corrections and improvements for better developer experience.
